name: smwmusic-knights-of-the-round-merlin
title: Knights of the Round - Merlin
description:
A nice water-y or ruins song with some big stakes involved.

I don't exactly know what its role was in-game since I discovered it browsing Zophar domain. So far it is the nicest track I could find in the whole OST, I hope you'll enjoy it as much as I do.

-------------
Important update:

On the former version, it was brought to my attention by Stivi, that calling Pause was not interrupting the song, but rather letting it freeze in place on the last played note.

It occurs on AddMusicK1.0.8 when channel #6, which plays the pause SFX, has noise inside, as explained by KungFuFurby and Kevin.

While I could have chosen to take #6's contents to channel #7, I found this choice inesthetical since #7 always gets cut with Jump or coin sounds. So I just replaced the noise sample of #6 by an external closed hat sample.
